messages:
sam-sales: Quick heads-up — Pioneer wants Redwood to complete their SIG/CAIQ for the POC. They sent the questionnaire and want certs and answers by EOD Friday. Can sec take point? Link: https://pioneer.example.com/sig-caicq :eyes:
ella-sec: Thanks Sam. Can you drop the PDF here and confirm which Redwood environment they will touch (sandbox vs dedicated)? We need the environment to map controls (network segmentation, logs).
anil-eng: They'll be using a short-lived dedicated pool for the POC (us-west). I mentioned no customer data will be uploaded, only synthetic prompts.
sam-sales: PDF attached in the thread. Env = dedicated-poc-usw, lifecycle = 2 weeks. Also ask legal about NDA scope — they included an aggressive data access clause.
ella-sec: OK — first pass: we'll run SIG mapping + vendor risk intake. Items I need from you by tomorrow: contract with clause, contact at Pioneer, and confirmation of infra config (VPC peering? or private link?).
vendor-risk-bot: Automated vendor intake: Pioneer Inc — preliminary risk score 62/100. Missing: SOC2 report, encryption at rest proof, SIEM integration docs. See https://vendor-risk.example.com/rdw/pioneer for details.
ella-sec: The bot found what I expected. We can provide our SOC2 summary and our KMS integration diagram. We should push back on the encryption-at-rest proof ask — we use cloud KMS; vendor asking for key material access is a no. @kate-legal can you weigh in on how to respond to the clause about key escrow?
kate-legal: Noted. I can draft a response rejecting key escrow and proposing acceptable attestations (SOC2 + encryption config). Also need the Pioneer contact. Sam can you confirm who will sign?
sam-sales: Contact is lori@pioneer.com, signatory is their procurement lead. I'll intro you both.
ella-sec: For the SIG/CAIQ I'll assign control owners and fill obvious yes/no answers. Question set where we need engineering input: C6 (network segmentation), C12 (key mgmt), A3 (incident response timelines). @anil-eng can you confirm whether dedicated-poc-usw has host-level segmentation and whether VPC flow logs are enabled?
anil-eng: Host segmentation = yes (namespaces + cgroup policies). VPC flow logs = enabled and shipped to our central SIEM. I can paste the minimal artifact: `s3://rdw-audit/poc-usw/flowlogs/` (access controlled).
ella-sec: Perfect. I'll reference that path in the CAIQ answers and note retention policies. Also will attach our SOC2 summary and a short KMS diagram.
sam-sales: Pioneer just pinged asking about encryption in transit and certs — they want TLS cipher list and cert chain. Who owns that?
anil-eng: App endpoints use TLS 1.3 with ciphers: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384. Certs from PublicCA; cert chain available in our repo: `infra/certs/public-chain.pem`.
ella-sec: Good. I'll paste that into the CAIQ comment field. One more blocker: Pioneer asked for a pen-test report within last 12 months — we have an internal pentest summary but not a redacted full report. @kate-legal any restrictions on sharing a redacted pentest?
kate-legal: We can share a redacted summary (no internal IPs, no specific exploit details). I'll prepare a one-page redacted cover to send.
ella-sec: Timeline plan: I will complete the CAIQ template with engineering inputs today, Kate will prepare the legal cover and redacted pentest, Sam will make the Pioneer intro. If Pioneer insists on key escrow, we respond with proposed attestations and escalate.
sam-sales: Sounds good. I'll intro Lori now.
ella-sec: One ask — can someone grant me reader access to the `s3://rdw-audit/poc-usw/flowlogs/` location so I can validate timestamps?
anil-eng: Granted reader access to you (ella-sec).
ella-sec: Got it. I'll upload the completed CAIQ PDF to the vendor portal and post link here when done. :thumbsup:
vendor-risk-bot: Update: Pioneer intake status -> evidence needed: SOC2 cert (uploaded), KMS diagram (pending), Pentest summary (pending). Current score 74/100 after SOC2 upload.
ella-sec: Uploaded CAIQ answers v1 to https://vendor-portal.pioneer.com/submissions/rdw-1769234567. Leaving comments where we redlined their clauses. I'll paste important excerpts below:
```
- Data access clause: We cannot provide access to key material or escrow. Proposed text: "Customer shall rely on vendor attestations and SOC2 audit reports; key material remains under vendor control."
- Incident notification: We accept 48-hour initial notification and 72-hour root cause follow-up for POC.
```

kate-legal: I'll send the NDA redline and the pentest redaction within the hour.
ella-sec: Great — if all items are green we can close intake today and allow sales to move forward with the POC. Thanks everyone."
